admission_price: General Admission $14.00 (3 and under free with paying adult); $18.00 during Haunting Hours (Fridays & Saturdays after 6pm in October). Pumpkins $4.00-$15.00 depending on size. Axe Throwing and Concessions priced separately.
activities: corn maze (The Maize); haunted maze section; spelunking cave (Speleo Cave); sports games (Farmin Ball Zone - football, basketball, baseball); cow train ride; hay ride; pumpkin patch; axe throwing; movie nights; sunflower photo ops; suicide prevention tractor exhibit
season_dates: September 11-30, 2026 (limited hours); October 2-31, 2026 (full season). Haunted Maize unavailable in September, available Fridays and Saturdays after 6pm in October.
extra_notes: Children under 15 must be accompanied by an adult at all times, or have valid photo ID. Speleo Cave recommended for individuals under 6'3" and less than 240 lbs. Group appointments available Monday-Tuesday for 15+ guests. Movie nights included with admission (Fridays and Saturdays, September 11-26). Concessions available.

extra_notes: Three experience levels offered: Family and Sensitivity Night (all ages welcome), Standard Nights (ages 14+ with parent for ages 14-17, under 14 not allowed), and X-Scream Nights (18+ only). Doors open at 6pm; frights run until 11pm (10pm on Thursdays). Experience includes loud sounds, low lighting, tripping hazards, intense special effects, sudden movements, and mature subject matter. No touching performers, eating, drinking, smoking, vaping, photography, running, or weapons. ADA friendly; guests may remain in wheelchairs. Intoxication and horseplay may result in expulsion. Security cameras throughout. Consult doctor if you have asthma, heart conditions, abnormal blood pressure, seizures, claustrophobia, or recent surgery.
